chunks: Bukayr ibn A‘yan narrated from Abū Ja‘far عليه السلام, who said:
“The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم never performed the Duha prayer.”

key_terms.أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ: Abū Ja‘far, Imam Muḥammad al-Bāqir عليه السلام
key_terms.الضُّحَى: the Duha prayer, a prayer associated with the forenoon time
key_terms.بُكَيْرُ بْنُ أَعْيَنَ: Bukayr ibn A‘yan, the narrator reporting this tradition
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.رَوَى: narrated; indicates transmission of the hadith
key_terms.قَطُّ: ever; used here for emphatic negation

ai.seo_question: Did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم ever pray the Duha prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith reports from Imam Abū Ja‘far عليه السلام that the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم never performed the Duha prayer. Its significance lies in describing prophetic practice as transmitted in Shia hadith literature, especially in discussions of recommended prayers and their legal status.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1561 - Bukayr ibn A'yan narrated from Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) that He said:
"The Messenger of Allah (sw) never prayed the Duha prayer."
